==English== {{swp}} ===Alternative forms=== * {{alt|en|lil|li'l|li'l'|lit'l|leetle|lickle|liddle|litle|lytel}} {{q|nonstandard, regional pronunciation spellings}} * {{alt|en|littel|lyttel|litel|lytell|litell|lytyll|lytle|lettel}} {{q|obsolete}} ===Etymology=== From {{inh|en|enm|litel}}, {{m|enm|litell}}, {{m|enm|luitel}}, {{m|enm|lutel}}, {{m|enm|lutil}}, {{m|enm|luytel}}, from {{inh|en|ang|lȳtel}}, {{m|ang|lyttel}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*lūtil|t=little}}, from {{m|gmw-pro|*lūtan|t=to bow down, lout}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*lūtaną|t=to bow down, lout}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*lewd-|t=to bend, crouch, duck}}. {{col-top|2|cog}} Cognate with {{cog|yol|lethel}}, {{m|yol|litha}}, {{m|yol|lithel}}, {{m|yol|lythea|t=little}}, {{cog|frr|letj|t=little, small}}, {{cog|stq|litje|t=little, small}}, {{cog|fy|lyts|t=little, small}}, {{cog|nl|luttel|t=few, little, mere}}, {{cog|de|lütt}}, {{m|de|lützel|t=little, small}}, {{cog|nds|lütt}}, {{m|nds|lüttje|t=little, small}}, {{cog|da|liden}}, {{m|da|lille|t=little, small}}, {{cog|ovd|litn|t=small}}, {{cog|fo|lítil|t=little, small}}, {{cog|is|lítill|t=little, small}}, {{cog|nb,nn,sv|liten|t=little, small}}, {{cog|gme-cgo|lista|t=insufficient, very little}}, {{cog|got|𐌻𐌴𐌹𐍄𐌹𐌻𐍃|t=little, small}}; also {{cog|sq|lus}}, {{m|sq|lut|t=to beg, plead, request}}, {{cog|lt|liūdnas|t=sad, sorrowful}}, {{cog|bg,mk|луд|t=crazy, insane, mad}}, {{cog|sh|лу̑д}}, {{m|sh|lȗd|t=crazy}}. Related also to {{cog|ang|lūtan|t=to bow, bend low}}; and perhaps to {{cog|ang|lytiġ|t=deceitful}}, {{cog|got|𐌻𐌹𐌿𐍄𐍃|t=deceitful}}. More at {{m|en|lout}}. {{col-bottom}} ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/ˈlɪ.tl̩/}} ** {{audio|en|En-uk-little.ogg|a=UK|IPA=[ˈlɪ.tʰɫ̩]}} ** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Naomi Persephone Amethyst (NaomiAmethyst)-little.wav|a=GA}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-little.ogg|a=US|IPA=[ˈɫɪ.ɾɫ̩]}} * {{IPA|en|[ˈlɪ.ɾɫ̩]|a=AU}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈlɘ.tl̩/|a=NZ}} ** {{audio|en|en-nz-little.ogg|a=NZ}} * {{IPA|en|/lɪʈl̩/|a=Indic}} ** {{IPA|en|[lɪʈ.ɐl]|a=North India}} ** {{IPA|en|[lɪʈ.(ʈ)ɨɭ]|a=South India}} * {{rhymes|en|ɪtəl|s=2}} * {{hmp|en|Littell|Lyttle}} * {{hyphenation|en|lit|tle}} ===Adjective=== {{en-adj|littler,lesser|sup=littlest,least}} # {{cap|small}}, [[not]] [[large]], [[limited]], ''[[particularly]]:'' #: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:small}} ## {{cap|small}}, [[limited]] in [[size]]. ##: {{ux|en|This is a '''little''' table.}} ## {{cap|short}}, [[limited]] in [[extent]]. ##: {{ux|en|It’s only a '''little''' ways now.}} ## {{cap|brief}}, [[limited]] in [[duration]]. ##: {{ux|en|I always feel better after a '''little''' sleep.}} ## {{cap|Young}}, [[limited]] in [[growth]]. ##: {{ux|en|Where's the [[little boys' room|'''little''' boys' room]]?}} ## {{lb|en|especially of siblings}} {{cap|Younger}}, [[regardless]] of [[size]] or [[height]]. ##: {{ux|en|You may be an Olympic weightlifter but you're still my [[little sister|'''little''' sister]].}} ## {{cap|undeveloped}} or [[underdeveloped]], [[limited]] in [[development]], particularly {{q|offensive|of a male}} in the [[genital]]s. ## {{cap|small}}, [[limited]] in [[number]], having [[few]] [[member]]s. ##: {{co|en|That's a mighty '''little''' herd you've got there.}} ## {{cap|insignificant}}, [[trivial]], [[limited]] in [[importance]]. ##: {{ux|en|It’s of '''little''' importance.}} ##* {{RQ:Tennyson In Memoriam|XXXVII|57|Urania speaks with darken’d brow:
⁠‘Thou pratest here where thou art '''least''';
⁠This faith has many a purer priest,
And many an abler voice than thou: {{...}}’}} ## {{lb|en|offensive}} {{cap|weak}}, [[inferior]], [[unimportant]], [[etc.]], {{n-g|used to [[belittle]] a person.}} ##: {{ux|en|Listen up, you '''little''' [[shit]].}} ## {{lb|en|with the name of a place, particularly a country or capital|often|capitalized}} {{non-gloss|Denoting a [[neighborhood]] whose [[resident]]s or [[storekeeper]]s are from that place.}} ## {{lb|en|with the name of a place, particularly a country|often|capitalized|derogatory}} {{n-g|Used with the name of a [[place]] to imply that the inhabitants have an insular attitude and are hostile to those they perceive as foreign.}} ## {{lb|en|derogatory}} {{cap|mean}}, [[selfish]], [[bigoted]], [[etc.]], [[limited]] in [[spirit]]. ##: {{ux|en|[[a foolish consistency is the hobgoblin of little minds|A foolish consistency is the hobgoblin of '''little''' minds]].}} ##* {{RQ:Tennyson Maud |page=20 |passage=The long-necked geese of the world that are ever hissing dispraise, / Because their natures are '''little'''.}} ##* {{quote-book|en|year=2001|author=Nicholas Petsalis-Diomidis|title=The Unknown Callas: the Greek Years|page=547 |passage=Showing unmistakably what a '''little''' person he really was, in June 1949 he wrote his newly married daughter with nauseating disregard for the truth}} ## {{lb|en|business|_|or|_|figurative|often|capitalized}} {{cap|independent}}, [[limited]] in [[scale]], [[especially]] [[contrast]]ed with [[well]]-[[organized]] and [[well]]-[[capitalized]] [[cartel]]s [[controlling]] [[most]] of an [[industry]], [[market]], [[etc.]] ##: {{ant|en|capital|big}} ##: {{ux|en|[[little science|'''Little''' Science]] vs [[Big Science]]... '''Little''' Steel vs Big Steel...}} ====Usage notes==== * Some authorities regard both '''littler''' and '''littlest''' as non-standard. The OED says of the word little: "''the adjective has no recognized mode of comparison. The difficulty is commonly evaded by resort to a synonym (as smaller, smallest); some writers have ventured to employ the unrecognized forms littler, littlest, which are otherwise confined to dialect or imitations of childish or illiterate speech.''" The forms '''lesser''' and '''least''' are encountered in animal names such as [[lesser flamingo]] and [[least weasel]]. ====Antonyms==== * {{antsense|small}} ''See'' [[Thesaurus:big]] * and, thus mounted, aim could be taken out of the window{{nb...}}, and a ‘bead’ could be drawn upon Molly, the dairymaid, kissing the fogger behind the hedge, '''little''' dreaming that the deadly tube was levelled at them.}} ====Usage notes==== Today, the use of "little" for ''not at all'' is mostly restricted to [[little did one know]] and similar constructions, like ''little did one realise'' or ''little did one care''. ====Antonyms==== * {{l|en|much}} ====Translations==== {{trans-top|not much}}{{multitrans|data= * Albanian: * Arabic: * Armenian: * Aromanian: * Asturian: * Bakhtiari: * Basque: * Belarusian: * Bengali: * Bulgarian: * Burmese: * Carpathian Rusyn: * Catalan: * Chamicuro: * Chinese: * Czech: * Danish: * Dutch: * Esperanto: * Estonian: * Faroese: * Finnish: * French: * Galician: * German: * Greek: * Gujarati: * Hebrew: * Hindi: * Hungarian: * Icelandic: * Ido: * Igbo: * Indonesian: * Ingrian: * Irish: * Italian: * Japanese: * Khmer: * Korean: * Kurdish: * Laboya: * Ladin: * Ladino: * Lao: * Latin: * Latvian: * Limburgish: * Lithuanian: * Macedonian: * Malayalam: * Mandar: * Norwegian: * Old English: * Pashto: * Persian: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Romanian: * Russian: {{tt+|ru|ма́ло}}, {{tt+|ru|немно́го}} * Sami: * Scottish Gaelic: * Serbo-Croatian: * Slovak: * Slovene: * Spanish: * Sundanese: * Swahili: * Swedish: * Thai: * Turkish: * Ukrainian: * Urdu: * Veps: * Vietnamese: * Volapük: * Võro: * Votic: }} {{trans-bottom}} ===Determiner=== {{head|en|determiner|comparative|less|superlative|least}} # Not [[much]], only [[a little]]: only a small amount (of). #: {{ux|en|There is (very) '''little''' water left.}} #: {{ux|en|We had very '''little''' to do.}} ====Usage notes==== : {{m|en||Little}} is used with uncountable nouns, {{m|en|few}} with plural countable nouns. : '''Little''' can be used with or without an article. With the indefinite article, the emphasis is that there is indeed some, albeit not much: :: {{usex|en|We have '''a little''' money, so we’ll probably get by.}} : With no article or the definite article (or [[what]]), the emphasis is on the scarcity: :: {{usex|en|We have '''little''' money, and '''little''' hope of getting more.}} :: {{usex|en|'''The little''' (or '''What little''') money we have is all going to pay for food and medication, so we can’t save any.}} ====Antonyms==== * {{antsense|not much}} {{l|en|much}} ====Translations==== {{trans-top|small amount}}{{multitrans|data= * Albanian: * Arabic: * Armenian: * Belarusian: * Bulgarian: * Burmese: * Carpathian Rusyn: * Catalan: * Cherokee: * Chinese: * Czech: * Danish: * Dutch: * Estonian: * Faroese: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Greek: * Greenlandic: * Hindi: * Hungarian: * Icelandic: * Igbo: * Indonesian: * Ingrian: * Irish: * Italian: * Jamaican Creole: * Japanese: * Khmer: * Korean: * Kurdish: * Ladin: * Ladino: * Lao: * Latin: * Latvian: * Lithuanian: * Macedonian: * Maltese: * Norwegian: * Pashto: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Romanian: * Russian: {{tt+|ru|ма́ло}} * Sami: * Scottish Gaelic: * Serbo-Croatian: * Slovak: * Slovene: * Spanish: * Sundanese: * Swahili: * Swedish: * Telugu: * Thai: * Ukrainian: * Urdu: * Veps: * Vietnamese: * Volapük: * Võro: * Votic: }} {{trans-bottom}} ====See also==== * {{l|en|a little}} ===Pronoun=== {{en-pron}} # Not much;
